title: VersionResponse
description: Which code the answering process runs. Returned by GET /v1/version to ANY authenticated caller (a credential is required when keys are configured, but no role is: nothing here is backend detail). The control plane (ADR-0007) reads it with a tenant's own key to show configured-vs-running on the fleet view. Python-only in v1 (ADR-0006 decision 4); the Go scaffold does not implement it, and `impl` says which implementation answered.

version.description: Package version from importlib.metadata; `0.1.0` when the package is not installed (a bare PYTHONPATH checkout).

git_tag.description: `RAGSTACK_GIT_TAG` when the supervisor set it (the artifact the tenant was launched from — what an operator comparing configured vs running wants), else `git describe --tags --always --dirty` run in the checkout the package was imported from, else null. Never an error: a version endpoint must not be the thing that 500s.

git_sha.description: `RAGSTACK_GIT_SHA` when set, else `git rev-parse --short HEAD` in the checkout, else null. Same fallback rules as `git_tag`.

started_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC wall-clock time this process started, captured once at import, with a trailing `Z` (e.g. `2026-09-11T04:12:00Z`) — the same spelling the control plane renders its own timestamps in.

impl.description: Which implementation answered. Only `python` exists in v1.
